# Mateus Bonette

> AI Engineer (Applied AI Engineer) and Software Engineer based in São Paulo, Brazil, specializing in AI Engineering, Harness Engineering, LLMs, RAG, AI Agents, Model Context Protocol (MCP), and Full Stack Software Engineering. Computer Science graduate from UNIFEI and postgraduate student in Applied AI Engineering at UNIPDS. Co-founder and Software & AI Engineer at Junta Já Brasil.

Last updated: 2026-11-24

## Summary

Mateus Bonette designs and ships production AI systems and full stack software integrating LLMs, RAG, AI agents, tool calling, and MCP servers with REST/GraphQL APIs and PostgreSQL/pgvector databases. His work pairs Applied AI Engineering with Harness Engineering — deterministic business rules, JSON schema validation, guardrails, Human-in-the-Loop (HITL) review, automated evaluations, LLM observability, and cost/fallback controls.

## Core Expertise

### AI Engineering (LLMs, RAG & AI Agents)
- Large Language Models (LLMs) & Generative AI: OpenAI API (GPT), Anthropic Claude, Google Gemini, Vertex AI, Ollama (local models), Hugging Face.
- Retrieval & Context: RAG, Agentic RAG, Embeddings, Vector Databases (pgvector), Semantic Search, Hybrid Search.
- Agent Frameworks & Protocols: Model Context Protocol (MCP), LangChain, LangGraph, CrewAI, Agent ADK, Multi-Agent Systems.
- Specialization: Prompt Engineering & Structured JSON Outputs, Fine-Tuning (LoRA & PEFT), Multimodal AI & Document OCR, Model Routing & Semantic Cache.

### Harness Engineering (Reliability, Observability & Control)
- Harness Engineering architecture separating probabilistic LLM interpretation from deterministic code execution.
- Tool Calling & strict tool contracts preventing unverified math or fabricated numbers.
- Guardrails, output schema validation, normalization, deduplication, and parameterized SQL queries.
- Human-in-the-Loop (HITL) review workflows for edge cases and auditability.
- LLM Observability & FinOps: Langfuse tracing, token/latency/error telemetry, document caching, model fallback, and monthly spend limits.
- Context Engineering, Agent Evals & automated testing, Spec-Driven Development (SDD), and Responsible AI governance.

### Software & AI Engineer (Co-founder) — Junta Já Brasil
- Period: Jun 2026 – Present | Location: São Paulo, Brazil (Remote)
- Co-founder responsible end to end for software and AI engineering of a personal financial management SaaS in production with 100+ users.
- Automated bill and bank statement reading using OCR, Gemini, and Vertex AI: over 1,000 statements processed (average 100+/month) with >90% extraction and categorization accuracy, JSON schema extraction, normalization, deduplication, and deterministic validation before PostgreSQL persistence, cutting organization time from hours to under 1 minute.
- Combined deterministic rules with Human-in-the-Loop (HITL) review for edge cases and quality tracking.
- Built Ari, a WhatsApp AI assistant using Tool Calling and live system APIs with Harness Engineering controls to prevent unverified calculations.

- Implemented LLM observability covering tokens, cost, latency, execution errors, document caching, model fallback, and monthly spend caps.
